hooks.name: reopen-case-on-fixture
hooks.description: When a fixture changes, reopen that case and summarise only what the record supports.

action.prompt: A fixture file changed. Re-run the inquest for that case using the project engine (npm test or the local API). Summarise the witness list and the verdict. Use only facts in the record. If a field is missing, say it is not in the record. Do not invent a reason for a failure.
